title: Degraded quality / brain fog on Opus 4.6 — April 3, 2026
body:
## Description

Experiencing significantly degraded response quality on Claude Opus 4.6 via Claude Code over the past few hours (April 3, 2026). Responses feel slow, unfocused, and lower quality than usual — "brain fog" is the best description.

## Context

- This follows known incidents from March 31 – April 1 (Opus 4.6 / Sonnet 4.6 timeouts, Haiku 4.5 elevated errors)
- Status page shows all clear as of April 2, but the degraded quality persists
- Fresh conversations don't resolve it
- Model: Claude Opus 4.6 via Claude Code CLI

## Expected behavior

Normal response quality and coherence.

## Actual behavior

Noticeably worse reasoning, coherence, and overall response quality compared to baseline.

## Environment

- Claude Code CLI (latest)
- macOS (Darwin 24.1.0)
- Model: claude-opus-4-6

I've been paying $200/month for Anthropic's top tier since October 2025. In that time the product I'm paying for has been silently changed at least three times in ways that materially degrade what I receive, and at no point was I notified. That is what this issue is about. It is not a bug report. It is a disclosure failure.
